comments.author: graphe
comments.story: What is trauma? The author of "The Body Keeps the Score" explains [video]
comments.why: Carlin skit on shell shock becoming PTSD
comments.text: PTSD is also lumped in with shell shock, a jarring of the braincase after explosions (usually during a war) with physical damage. It's unthinkable to me they lump it in with mental problems. George Carlin skit. [VIDEO]

comments.author: racked
comments.story: Tesla sued for severe harassment of Black workers at California plant
comments.why: Carlin on symbolic renaming that changes nothing
comments.text: It really is not about that. The problem is that some people feel the need to bend over backwards, making symbolic gestures that do not change the underlying issue. As if renaming 'whitelist' to 'allowlist' is going to turn any neo-nazis into angels. George Carlin had a word or two to say about this phenomenon: [VIDEO]

comments.author: yamrzou
comments.why: Carlin on soft language and Americans' trouble facing reality
comments.text: "You can't be afraid of words that speak the truth. Even if it's an unpleasant truth ... I don't like words that hide the truth, I don't like words that conceal reality, I don't like euphemisms, and American English is loaded with euphemisms, because Americans have a lot of trouble with reality. Americans have trouble facing the truth, so they invent the kind of a soft language to protect themselves from it. And it gets worse with every generation." - George Carlin on Soft Language ( [VIDEO] )

comments.author: smcnally
comments.why: Carlin on how the term 'shell shock' mattered for veterans
comments.text: “I’ll betcha, if we’da still been calling it ‘Shell Shock,’ some of those Vietnam veterans might have gotten the attention they needed at the time.” — George Carlin [VIDEO]
